story: Real-time personalization. A grocery shopper browses aisles, searches, and fills a basket. Snowplow creates the behavioral data as it happens; Signals computes live shopper attributes from the stream. The demo shows how a grocery site can read purchase intent mid-session and adapt — surfacing the right offer, reassurance, or recommendation before the shopper abandons. Sets up a downstream layer where semantic judgments (what the shopper is actually trying to buy) are derived from the behavioral signal rather than from counts alone.

pages.name: Homepage
pages.description: Storefront entry. Hero with delivery-slot prompt, featured aisles, seasonal promo rail, and a reorder-favourites strip.

pages.name: Category / Aisle
pages.description: Product listing for an aisle (Produce, Dairy & Eggs, Bakery, Meat & Fish, Pantry, Frozen, Drinks, Household). Dense grid with filters and sort.

pages.name: Product detail
pages.description: Single product view with imagery, price per unit, nutrition and allergen panel, and related products.

pages.name: Cart
pages.description: Real basket state. Line items with quantity edits, running subtotal, delivery threshold progress, and removal.

pages.name: Checkout
pages.description: Multi-step conversion funnel: delivery slot selection, address, payment, confirmation.

designReference.notes: Modern grocery ecommerce: clean and fresh without being saccharine. Dense product grids with high information density (price per unit, dietary badges, stock state). Restrained colour — one confident produce-green accent against warm neutrals, colour reserved for price, promo and state. Asymmetric homepage layout, not a generic card-grid template.
